attempts.disposition: The sandbox denied loopback binds. The scoped outside-sandbox repository check passed.
An unrelated Homebrew tap shadowed Zig. A second qualified formula attempt had the same result.
The official pinned Zig archive built the pinned Ghostty source in isolated temporary storage.
The first Ghostty probe link omitted IOSurface and the C++ runtime. The bounded probe added the required platform linkage.
The first resize assertion observed asynchronous initialization. The strengthened probe matched both requested sizes and passed.
Computer Use could not address the temporary native bundle. The receipt keeps the visual limitation explicit and makes no screenshot claim.
A red regression proved that a maximum-depth host marker path exceeded the shared parser bound. The parser now accepts every bounded host-produced path.
A red native-origin preflight regression returned 403. Exact Tauri and local Vite origins now pass strict protected CORS checks.
The real Studio run found that Town published point lights but omitted semantic world and event views. A red demo regression led the runtime adapter to derive both views.

The automated occluded webview stayed in initializing state, so pause_simulation correctly returned ANTIKY_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE. Permanent parity and native-origin tests prove the ready-runtime control path.
No attached browser existed, and Computer Use could not capture the bundled Studio window. No unrelated browser driver or synthetic screenshot replaced it.
